rule_notes.OP01: Reader-benefit clarification is editorial; has_body is deterministic and reader_benefit_clear requires semantic review.
rule_notes.OP02: Correct or narrow an unmet opening promise; no unsupported factual additions or guaranteed dwell-time claim.
rule_notes.OP03: Add minimum context when reaching new readers; do not claim replies lack platform value.
rule_notes.OP04: Organize genuinely reusable scattered information; no engagement farming or recommendation-points claim.
rule_notes.OP05: Substantive repetition requires real history references and exact semantic review, not lexical similarity.
rule_notes.OP06: Complete critical facts, dates and assets; no universal post lifetime or optimal posting-time claim.
rule_notes.OP07: Real-question/discussion signals authorize editorial response advice only; SC05 is not evidence that replying increases a mechanism score.
rule_notes.OP08: Sensitive or weakly supported claims and actual warnings justify sourcing/caution; no inference of hidden labels from low exposure.
rule_notes.OP09: Choose visuals for the reader task when requested; no universal media bonus or image-count rule.
rule_notes.OP10: Relevant topics plus genuine contribution support editorial suggestions; do not fabricate personal experience or guarantee growth.
